name: Advanced Filesystem: Remote Sync
description: Pulls files from a remote Drupal server running the same module over HTTP Basic Auth, so a freshly migrated site can fetch its uploaded files on demand or in bulk after only the database was imported.
project_description: Advanced Filesystem: Remote Sync is a submodule of Advanced Filesystem Backup that transfers files between two Drupal sites running the module. On the source (old) server it exposes two authenticated read-only HTTP endpoints — a paginated file listing and a single-file download — protected by HTTP Basic Auth plus the restricted permission 'access advanced_filesystem_remote_sync api'. On the destination (new) server an admin configures the source base URL, service-account credentials and the stream-wrapper schemes to pull, then runs a Batch API job that paginates the remote listing and downloads each file into the matching local stream-wrapper URI. It solves the common migration situation where a database dump has been imported to a new server but the public:// / private:// files still live on the old one, removing the need for a manual rsync before go-live. TLS verification is on by default (toggleable for self-signed dev certs), overwrite and per-step chunk size are configurable, and a Test connection button validates the setup before a full sync.
